Card Q&A.a: It refers to when you have the specified card in the battle area or breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: What does "while you have (the specified card) on the field" mean, exactly?

Effect: While you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [ADVENTURE] trait on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] ＜Draw 2＞. (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your level 5 or higher Digimon would leave the battle area, ＜Delay＞. (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect.)
・You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with the [ADVENTURE] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
Security Effect: [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
